description: This file defines the ListInfoRenderer class which is responsible for rendering list information into RTF format within the MigraDoc document rendering library. It manages list IDs, handles different list types, and outputs corresponding RTF control sequences.

classes.name: ListInfoRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class responsible for converting ListInfo objects into RTF list representations.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets static list ID mappings and counters.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders the associated ListInfo object into RTF format, managing list IDs and continuity.

methods.name: GetListID
methods.description: Retrieves the list ID associated with a given ListInfo object.

methods.name: WriteListLevel
methods.description: Writes the list level part of the RTF, determining bullet or numbered list styles.

methods.name: GetBulletItemText2
methods.description: Returns the RTF-compatible control string for a given bullet character.

methods.name: WriteListLevel
methods.description: Constructs the RTF controls for list level formatting, including bullet/number style and font.
